{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.06

|gr1= Tasks

|arg= global

|eff= global

|descr= Deletes given task. {{Feature|informative| See [[Arma 3: Task Framework]].}}

|s1= [taskID, owner, removeFromJIP] call [[BIS_fnc_deleteTask]]

|p1= taskID: [[String]] - ID of the task

|p2= owner: [[String]] - (Optional) owner of the task. Can be:
* [[Boolean]] - true to use all playable units
* [[Object]] - specific object
* [[Group]] - all objects in the group
* [[Side]] - all objects of the given side
* [[Array]] - collection of above types

|p3= removeFromJIP: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to also remove task from JIP queue
|p3since= arma3 2.08

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>["task_1"] call BIS_fnc_deleteTask;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>["task_1", west] call BIS_fnc_deleteTask;</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>["task_1", [west, player, group soldier]] call BIS_fnc_deleteTask;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Task Framework]]
}}
